Asha (Design): quick check — in compact forms (dense rows, multi-column), are we leaning inline errors only or inline + a top summary for destructive/required flows? thinking about scanability and keyboard users :thinking_face: Leo (PM): +1 to deciding. Metrics question: how often do users trigger the summary vs rely on field-level? any telemetry? Asha (Design): we don't have explicit telemetry for summary clicks. mostly qualitative from usability tests — users miss inline errors when scanning quickly. Maria (Design): for destructive actions (delete pool, purge keys) I worry typed-confirm in compact modals is too heavy visually. maybe a compact typed-confirm variant: single-line input with placeholder "type DELETE to confirm" and lower visual weight. Kai (Engineering): implementation note: typed-confirm adds complexity for screen readers and focus. we need to manage focus on the input and ensure form validation messages are exposed via aria-live. also watch tab order when we hide/show error summary. Priya (Accessibility): agree. recommendation: always expose summary with role="region" and aria-label="Error summary" and set focus to it after submit failure. inline errors should use `role=alert` or `aria-live="assertive"` for critical errors. for required markers, use visually hidden text like "required" rather than relying on color. Jae (Frontend): example markup that worked for us: ```
2 problems found
Name is required
``` Kai (Engineering): that pattern is good. for compact we should avoid big summary banners — make summary visually minimal but keyboard-focusable. maybe 1-line summary with a short bulleted list collapsed/expandable. Asha (Design): what about microcopy for the summary header? something like "We couldn't save — 2 problems" vs "Please fix 2 errors"? shorter is better in dense layouts. Maria (Design): suggestion: header = "Fix 2 issues" and the expand link = "View details". keeps it short. Leo (PM): decision needed: default = inline + minimal summary (collapsed) that expands on focus or when user presses a keyboard shortcut? also need fallback for mobile. Priya (Accessibility): keyboard: when validation fails, focus on summary. If user hits Esc, allow closing and focus returns to first invalid input. For mobile, ensure announcements through TalkBack/VoiceOver — minimal summary + inline errors pretty reliable. Jae (Frontend): we can add a `data-error-summary-mode="collapsed"` flag and toggle with JS. rough sketch: ``` if (submitFailed) { summaryEl.focus(); summaryEl.classList.add('expanded'); } ``` Kai (Engineering): perf note: avoid layout shift when expanding. animate height with transform and keep initial space reserved. Asha (Design): destructive confirm copy — can we standardize: short label + explanation + action verb. e.g. Title: "Delete pool" Body: "This will permanently delete X and cannot be undone." Confirm button: "Delete pool" Cancel: "Cancel". keep typed-confirm optional for high-risk resources. Maria (Design): typed-confirm should be gated by a risk score. low-risk: checkbox + bold action. high-risk: typed-confirm. also document in UX kit. Leo (PM): sounds good. follow-up: can design team draft two microcopy variants for compact vs regular modals? we can A/B in staging. Asha (Design): I'll mock variants and post screenshots. quick poll: prefer minimal summary collapsed by default? react with :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no. Kai (Engineering): :thumbsup: Priya (Accessibility): :thumbsup: Jae (Frontend): :thumbsup: Maria (Design): :thumbsdown: (prefer expanded by default for novice flows) Leo (PM): noted. action items: Asha/Maria to produce copies and mocks; Jae/Kai to prototype collapsed summary behavior with aria handling; Priya to review a11y checklist. I'll file a small ticket to record decision and telemetry needed. Asha (Design): thanks — will post mocks by EOD and include copy variations. (automated) design-bot: created ticket D-4281 "Compact form validation — collapsed summary + typed-confirm gating" assigned to Asha, due next sprint.
